{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_age_converted)"}
